data.rationale: This commit changes foreign key (RI) check execution in ri_triggers.c so that FK checks needing implicit cast functions use SPI instead of the fast path, while binary-coercible and domain types remain on the fast path. The function ri_check_fastpath_index evaluates pg_cast eligibility and caches the result. To execute the modified lines in ri_triggers.c, the fuzzer needs to add foreign key constraints across different compatible types (such as int to bigint or custom implicit casts) and run INSERT/UPDATE statements that trigger RI checks.
data.grammar_fragment:
alter_table @scope
  : <2> ALTER TABLE @target(plain) ADD FOREIGN KEY "(" @target_col(int) ")" REFERENCES "t1" "(" "c0" ")" NOT VALID
  | <2> ALTER TABLE @target(plain) ADD FOREIGN KEY "(" @target_col(bigint) ")" REFERENCES "t1" "(" "c0" ")" NOT VALID
  ;
